cards.text: After a demanding week, recovery comes more from solitude on the left or active connection on the right?
When an idea is forming, do you prefer to think privately first on the left or discover it by talking on the right?
When learning something new, do concrete examples orient you first on the left or an underlying pattern on the right?
When plans are uncertain, do you trust observable details first on the left or emerging possibilities on the right?
In a hard decision, do consistent principles lead on the left or the effects on particular people on the right?
When giving feedback, do you first test logical soundness on the left or relational impact on the right?
For a complex project, do you prefer early closure and a stable plan on the left or room to revise late on the right?
Does momentum come more from committing to a sequence on the left or responding to what emerges on the right?

note: Never assign a four-letter type; never claim equivalence with a branded instrument.
